definitions.explanation: A unit of speed measuring the distance traveled per second. Often expressed as {秒速|びょうそく}〜メートル (~ meters per second).

examples.japanese: ⟦{光|ひかり}→光：01707_hikari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{秒速|びょうそく}⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧30{万|まん}⟦キロメートル→キロメートル：02873_kiromeetoru⟧だ。
examples.english: Light travels at approximately 300,000 kilometers per second.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{風速|ふうそく}→風速：24554_fuusoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{秒速|びょうそく}50⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: The wind speed of the typhoon reached 50 meters per second.

examples.japanese: ⟦{音|おと}→音：00743_oto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{速|はや}さ→速さ：28072_hayasa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{空気中|くうきちゅう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{秒速|びょうそく}⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧340⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧だ。
examples.english: The speed of sound in air is approximately 340 meters per second.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in scientific contexts and weather reports. Wind speed in Japan is typically expressed in {秒速|びょうそく} (meters per second), unlike some countries that use kilometers per hour.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秒速|びょうそく}〜⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧ (~ meters per second)
- {秒速|びょうそく}〜⟦キロメートル→キロメートル：02873_kiromeetoru⟧ (~ kilometers per second)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{時速|じそく}→時速：00128_jisoku⟧: speed per hour — kilometers per hour
- ⟦{分速|ふんそく}→分速：16680_funsoku⟧: speed per minute — meters per minute
- ⟦{風速|ふうそく}→風速：24554_fuusoku⟧: wind speed — the speed of wind
